name: New Thalanaar
summary: New Thalanaar does not exist in the present era of 25 ADP. The original outpost of Thalanaar still stands proudly atop the border pass between Feralas and Thousand Needles, serving as a vigilant Alliance boundary post under the stewardship of the Sentinels.

sections.title: The True Frontier: Thalanaar
sections.body: Travelers journeying between Thousand Needles and Feralas will find no settlement named New Thalanaar, for the original border outpost of Thalanaar remains intact and high above the canyon floor. Established by the night elves to safeguard the eastern approach into the lush wilderness of Feralas, the watchpost serves as a crucial respite and staging ground for Alliance scouts, couriers, and warriors traversing southern Kalimdor.

faq.answer: New Thalanaar does not exist in this era. The outpost you are looking for is simply Thalanaar, situated right on the eastern threshold of Feralas overlooking Thousand Needles.
No. Thousand Needles remains a dry, wind-scoured canyon of towering sandstone spires, and Thalanaar stands undamaged upon the high border cliffs.
While Grimtotem tauren inhabit regions of Thousand Needles and Feralas, Thalanaar is not under active siege. The Sentinels maintain orderly command of their watchpost and the border road.

angles.text: Thalanaar is your people's easternmost bulwark into Feralas, guarding the verdant forests against intrusions from the arid canyonlands below.
Thalanaar provides vital flight paths and refuge for Alliance travelers crossing through southern Kalimdor.
